summary: All three new features verified end-to-end (backend + mobile UI). Backend: 23/23 pytest pass including new TestWeeklyRecap and TestProgramHistory suites. Frontend: (1) Paywall shows both plan-monthly ($5.00) and plan-annual ($39.99, 'SAVE 33%' badge, '$3.33/mo · billed yearly'); the paywall-purchase button reactively updates ('SUBSCRIBE — $5.00' ↔ 'SUBSCRIBE — $39.99') when toggling plan cards. (2) Weekly Recap opens from dashboard 'open-recap' → shows XP GAINED (340), SESSIONS (4), NEW PRs (1), TOTAL VOLUME MOVED (7480 lb), PR list (Bench Press — 255 lb), promo banner ('RANKED UP: INTERMEDIATE → ADVANCED'), and a functional recap-share button. Endpoint reflects new workouts correctly (workouts+1, xp+gain, volume += 1990, pr_count+1 verified via pytest). (3) Program History: elite@test.com Athletes Center has 'ac-tab-build' + 'ac-tab-history (5)'; history tab lists ac-history-* items; tapping one populates the build view with 'YOUR CUSTOM PROTOCOL'. GET /api/ai/programs returns programs with program_id/program_text/created_at/request fields, no mongo _id leak, and new POST /api/ai/build-workout entries appear immediately in the list. Regressions verified: fresh registered user sees CIRCLE LOCKED on community and ADVANCED RANK REQUIRED on athletes-center; monthly price $5.00 still correct. Deprecated packages detected: none from expo-av/barcode/background-fetch. Only non-blocking React Native deprecation warnings for legacy 'textShadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — flagged in iteration_2 already, still present.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Still present since iteration_2. Search styles for textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius and consolidate into a single textShadow property.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Move any pointerEvents prop passed to components into their style object.

action_items: Optional cleanup only: migrate deprecated 'textShadow*' style props to consolidated 'textShadow' and move pointerEvents into style objects.
critical_code_review_comments: paywall.tsx correctly derives price via pkg.product.priceString with sensible $5.00/$39.99 fallbacks; savingsPct math uses monthlyAmount*12 comparison so any future price change auto-updates the badge.
recap.tsx handles the zero-workouts empty state via 'No sessions logged this week' message; server always returns a full shape so the card does not crash.

athletes-center.tsx loadHistory catches errors silently — acceptable for a non-critical secondary panel; tapping a history card correctly hydrates the build view and preserves the tab counter (history.length).
GET /api/ai/programs excludes _id via projection; response contains user_id which is not sensitive but could be omitted for cleanliness.
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway account for gating regression test; TestWorkouts and TestWeeklyRecap logged additional workouts on athlete@test.com (this pushed athlete's rank from Intermediate → Advanced during the run, expected side-effect of repeated pytest runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: athlete@test.com may now be at Advanced rank in the running DB because TestWorkouts and TestWeeklyRecap add workouts each run. The seed function is idempotent (skips existing users), so athlete rank/XP won't reset unless the DB is wiped. If a future test needs Intermediate specifically, use a freshly registered user. Elite already skool-verified as side-effect of TestAI. Paywall/Recap/Program History testIDs: plan-monthly, plan-annual, paywall-purchase, open-recap, recap-share, ac-tab-build, ac-tab-history, ac-history-<program_id>, open-athletes-center, open-paywall-profile (inside Profile / tab-profile).
rca_of_issue: n/a — feature addition iteration, no bugs found.
